description: Send a chat completion through P402's AI router. Automatically selects the best provider based on routing mode (cost / quality / speed / balanced). Settles per-request in USDC.e on Tempo or USDC on Base.

analytics_tag.description: Free-form attribution tag echoed in p402_metadata and traffic analytics (e.g. 'research-agent', 'code-review').

mode.description: Routing mode — cost minimises price, quality maximises model capability, speed minimises latency, balanced is the default

model.description: Pin a specific model (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022). Omit to let the router choose.

preferred_rail.description: Settlement rail: auto (default, picks cheaper healthy rail), tempo (Tempo mainnet USDC.e, chain 4217), or base (Base mainnet USDC/EURC, chain 8453).

session_id.description: Session ID for budget tracking. The cost of this call is deducted from the session budget.

name: p402_chat
